title: Sore spot under a lower denture

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: My grandson graduated from college on Saturday, I'm so proud.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Congratulations! So tell me about the denture.

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: The lower one rubs on the left side, it's really sore when I chew.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: There's an ulcer on the lower left ridge under the denture flange.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: I'm adjusting the lower denture, relieving the flange over that spot.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Rinse with warm salt water and come back in a week if it's not healing.
